name: Sapphire
overview: Scripture presents sapphire as a precious and valued stone, notable for its deep blue color reminiscent of the expanse or firmament above, as seen in Ezekiel's vision of the throne (Ezekiel 1:26). It is included among the precious stones adorning the high priest's breastplate (Exodus 28:18) and is highlighted as a symbol of beauty and strength in God's promises, such as the foundations of the New Jerusalem and the restored city in Isaiah (Isaiah 54:11). The rarity and worth of sapphire are emphasized in Job, where it is compared to gold and other precious gems (Job 28:6, 16), underscoring its significance both in creation and divine revelation.
